Mr Rao frowned. "The 15th sounds late."

He agreed to the 15th. The press was delayed by a day. The papers were ready on the 13th. Mr Rao stopped by her desk with a cup of tea.

qa.a: Mr Rao was doubtful and a little unhappy, since the 15th sounded late with parents waiting.

qa.a: It was based on how long the task really took in the last three years plus a buffer for the delay that happened every year.
